bridge-type.label: MELCloud Home Account (Experimental)
bridge-type.description: Account bridge for the newer MELCloud Home cloud platform (auth.melcloudhome.com). See ADR-002: logs in with your MELCloud Home email and password, running the full OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code + PKCE flow (including the AWS Cognito-federated credential submission) entirely in the background, and keeps the resulting access token refreshed for use by ATA/ATW unit Things (see ADR-003).

parameter.name: username
parameter.label: Email
parameter.description: The email address used to sign in to the MELCloud Home app.

parameter.name: password
parameter.label: Password
parameter.description: The password used to sign in to the MELCloud Home app.
